protocolSteps.summary: With these parameters, we optimized a freezing protocol in a programmable freezer (Nano-Digitcool, Cryo Bio System) and a thawing protocol.

evidence.text: With these parameters, we optimized a freezing protocol in a programmable freezer (Nano-Digitcool, Cryo Bio System) and a thawing protocol.

protocolSteps.summary: The freezing curve was as follows: 5 min at 4 °C, 1 °C/min to -7 °C, seeding: -60 °C/min to -32 °C, and 10 °C/min to -15 °C, 0.3 °C/min to -40 °C, 10 °C/min to -140 °C.

evidence.text: The freezing curve was as follows: 5 min at 4 °C, 1 °C/min to -7 °C, seeding: -60 °C/min to -32 °C, and 10 °C/min to -15 °C, 0.3 °C/min to -40 °C, 10 °C/min to -140 °C.

protocolSteps.summary: The thawing protocol consisted in a 3.5-min step in a cold chamber to reach slowly Tg’, limiting thermal and mechanical shocks, and then a 2-min incubation at 37 °C to quickly reach Tm.

evidence.text: The thawing protocol consisted in a 3.5-min step in a cold chamber to reach slowly Tg’, limiting thermal and mechanical shocks, and then a 2-min incubation at 37 °C to quickly reach Tm.

protocolSteps.summary: Ovarian tissue frozen-thawed according to these protocols had a similar quality to that of fresh tissue and could resume folliculogenesis during organotypic culture.
